codes.condition: The resolved key's body is empty or its checksum differs, by the key-format rule; the client sends it anyway.
A character of the resolved key after its prefix is outside base62, by the key-format rule; the client sends it anyway.
The resolved key starts with neither dfo_k_ nor dfo_p_, by the key-format rule; the client sends it anyway.
A ref member's content_version serves a file whose digest differs from the ref's, because the server rendered the same data again; the client returns the data.
An API response carries a Deprecation or Sunset header, once per process per distinct pair of their values.
An API response carries an x-dfo-warning header, once per process per message.
